stem: Which of these is a grievance from the Declaration of Independence?

options.label: A
options.text: Colonists born in America were prohibited from holding elected office.

options.label: B
options.text: Colonists were forced to quarter troops in their homes.

options.label: C
options.text: Colonists were not eligible to become officers in the British army.

options.label: D
options.text: Colonists were required to serve a year in their colony's militia.
